originality.rationale: PASS: fused literature search over all providers with no partial failure, plus a full-text fetch of the nearest prior work, shows the exact conditioned gap is new. Bruns-Garcia-Sanchez-O'Neill-Wilburne (2019) prove Wilf (W>=0) for m<=18, strictly weaker than W>=3 on the (m=6,t=3) locus; Wilf-function/concentration (Almiron-Moyano), high-embedding-dimension (Sammartano), e>t-implies-Wilf, and genus-bounded censuses likewise conclude only W>=0 or restrict types, and no GAP/table entry records this universal gap. Equivalent phrasings, broader theorems, exact databases, and prior-implication were each tested in decisive_checks; no source states or substantively implies W>=3 for all multiplicity-6 type-3 semigroups.

value.rationale: PASS (TARGET route): the admitted target is a natural infinite-family cutoff advancing the recognized Wilf problem, a type-conditioned gap W>=3 for all multiplicity-6 type-3 semigroups, motivated before computation. It is not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, or unexplained enumeration. Box exhaustion (690 type-3 tuples, min W=4) and random sampling show a non-vacuous boundary with one unit of slack; the unexhibited extremal W=3 witness is an honestly disclosed limitation, not a value defect under the shared standard.

checked_sources: Bruns-Garcia-Sanchez-O'Neill-Wilburne 2019 'Wilf's conjecture in fixed multiplicity' (arXiv:1903.04342, full text fetched): proves W>=0 for m<=18 via Kunz faces; strictly weaker than W>=3 on (m=6,t=3); no type-conditioned gap stated.
Almiron-Moyano-Fernandez (2021/2022) Wilf function, concentration and Eliahou number: bounds minimal positive Wilf values via concentration; different conditioning; does not imply the (6,3) gap.
Sammartano large-embedding-dimension (2e>=m implies Wilf) and e>t implies Wilf: yield W>=0 only; no W>=3 gap for the (6,3) locus.
GAP numericalsgps tables, Fromentin-Hivert genus<=60 census, Normaliz Kunz-face data: finite enumerations for W>=0; do not cover the infinite (m=6,t=3) family.

broader_coverage.reasoning: A broader result covers the claim only if it implies W>=3 on the (6,3) locus. W>=0 does not imply W>=3, and bounded-genus censuses do not imply an infinite-family gap, so no broader theorem subsumes the claim.
